  y=6   ...#......

  y=4   ..G.++.+.+
  y=3   .#.##.#.#.
  y=2   .#.##.#.#.
  y=1   P.+..+.+..

- Columns x = 1..10, rows y = 1..6 (y grows upwards). Pac-Man starts at (1, 1) heading right; both ghosts start at
  (3, 4) heading right.
- Each round ghost 0 moves, then ghost 1, then Pac-Man. A crash is Pac-Man and a ghost on the same cell after any
  move. The game ends after MAXSTEPS Pac-Man moves.
- In a corridor Pac-Man keeps going in his heading and turns at corners (forced; rules have no effect there). At a
  crossing (3, 1), (6, 1), (8, 1), (3, 4), (5, 4), (6, 4), (8, 4), (10, 4) the rules choose right, up, left or down; a direction with a wall

- **Elsewhere:** At each other crossing, I want Pac-Man to take a non-wall direction that does not shorten his distance to either ghost, and to fall back to weaker constraints when that is impossible. - **Length independence:** No rule mentions `steps`, `moves_left` or `MAXSTEPS`. Ghost removal near the end already lowers the threat, so the same ordering works for short and long games.
- **Fallback:** The final `true` rule gives a fixed direction, so the controller never reaches a state where no rule applies.

```json
  {"condition": "!wall & !closer_g0 & !closer_g1", "action": "any"},
  {"condition": "!wall & !closer_g0", "action": "any"},
  {"condition": "!wall & !closer_g1", "action": "any"},
  {"condition": "!wall", "action": "any"},
  {"condition": "true", "action": "right"}
]}
```
